blocking_issues: JsonResponseCodec.decode does not return its closed DecodeResult for deeply nested stored JSON. json_response.py:79-84 catches RecursionError from json.loads but calls _valid_json_tree outside the try; a parseable array nested 600 levels raises RecursionError instead of returning InvalidPayload(). ResponseReuseProtocol.lookup therefore propagates that data-dependent exception instead of Unavailable(INVALID_PAYLOAD), contrary to the approved fix-3 expected-failure value contract. Handle recursion from validation as InvalidPayload and add a direct codec plus protocol regression using a parseable deeply nested JSON payload, while preserving unexpected program-error propagation.
